svg.title: online softmax
svg.text: 5. Online softmax across the tiles: running m, l and acc [64]
context 300 → 3 tiles of 128; after each tile the old totals are rescaled by alpha, then the new tile is added
state of ONE program (float32, in registers)
alpha = exp(m − m_new) (≤ 1: old totals shrink)
acc = acc·alpha + tl.sum(p[:, None] · v, axis=0) [128, 64] → [64]

svg.text: Only one tile is ever held: memory per program is O(128 × 64), whatever the context length.
Exact, not approximate: rescaling by alpha turns every old e^(s − m_old) into e^(s − m_new).
